title: Linear Workspace Specification
description: Machine-readable spec of the canonical Linear workspace topology governed by HOMEBASE-SOP-013. Used by `homebase roadmap audit` to detect drift between live Linear state and the expected shape defined in standards/LINEAR_WORKSPACE.md.

single_workspace.description: Only one Linear workspace is authorized. Do not create a second.

api_key_source.description: Per-machine env file containing LINEAR_API_KEY=... (chmod 600). Checked by scripts/roadmap/linear.rb and scripts/lib/linear-api-helper.sh after $LINEAR_API_KEY in the process environment.

teams.description: Canonical Team registry (monorepos). Every entry MUST exist in Linear; no additional teams may exist without being added here first.

projects.description: Canonical Projects (apps) registry. Each Project lives inside a Team.

app_slug.description: App slug as it appears in registry/PROJECTS.md.

team_key.description: Team the app's Project lives inside.

name.description: Project name (the app's display name; no version suffix).

owner_agent.description: PM agent with scope and priority authority for this Project.

canonical_labels.description: Every Team MUST have these labels. Additional per-Project labels are permitted but must not collide.

milestone_naming.description: Milestones represent releases. Name format is strict SemVer.

snapshot_freshness_hours.description: Maximum age of registry/roadmap-snapshot.yml before audit fails.
